parameters.name: pids_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of processes in the container (docker run --pids-limit; Engine API HostConfig.PidsLimit). A positive integer.

parameters.name: memory_limit
parameters.description: Memory limit of the container (docker run --memory; Engine API HostConfig.Memory, in bytes): a positive integer followed by m (MiB) or g (GiB).

parameters.name: container_name
parameters.description: Container name chosen by the core.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: One label as key=value: the ownership labels of registry/ownership.json and accepted caller labels, in its charset.

description.ru: Diagnostic-контейнер smoke test (CF16): без загрузки образа, без сети, без capabilities, без повышения привилегий, с корневой ФС только для чтения, с ограничением числа процессов и памяти. Контейнер удаляется после каждого запуска — также при ошибке, таймауте и отмене.
description.en: The diagnostic container of the smoke test (CF16): no image pull, no network, no capabilities, no privilege escalation, a read-only root filesystem, a process limit and a memory limit. The container is removed after every run, also after a failure, a timeout and a cancellation.

profiles.note: SEC-15. The values of pids_limit and memory_limit are fixed here as `limits` together with the diagnostic image protocol (CR-57: compute, persistent state, logs, stop), before the first diagnostic image is allowlisted; until then they are provisional client constants and tools/validate.py refuses a diagnostic allowlist entry. The option set is closed and every option group occurs exactly once: an option the diagnostic protocol needs (for example the mount of its state volume) is added here with CR-57, not by a client. Nothing follows the image reference (no command, no arguments); with the Engine API Config carries only Image and Labels until CR-57. CR-57 also decides --user, --memory-swap and --cpus (CR-76).

description.ru: Worker-контейнер (обучение, задачи узла). Профиль запуска ещё не определён: он требует отдельного security review.
description.en: The worker container (training, node tasks). The run profile is not defined yet: it needs its own security review.

profiles.note: To be defined with its own security review. Until then no worker container is run and no worker image is allowlisted. Sprut invariant 2 holds in any case: no Docker socket, no privileged mode, no host-root mounts, no host network.
